audit_items.proof_trace: Both ADL liquidation functions (`handle_debt_auto_deleverage` L590 and `handle_collateral_auto_deleverage` L658) hardcode `liquidation_revenue_factor: float::zero()` in the `LiquidationParams` struct — this value is not derived from any configurable admin parameter. The `DeleverageParams` struct contains no revenue factor field, so no admin action can inject a non-zero value. The zero is passed unchanged to `liquidation_inner` → `liquidate_ctokens` (L780), confirming no protocol revenue is extracted during ADL.
